The paper claims the improvement stems from the *selection mechanism* rather than *data quantity*, but this hypothesis is not rigorously tested. Without an ablation where a baseline is given a replay buffer of equivalent total size, it is impossible to know if the gains are due to the intelligent relearning algorithm or simply the benefit of having more past data available.
